blogs.title: Breaking the Bottleneck: How FlashAttention-3 Supercharges LLMs
blogs.description: An introductory overview of FlashAttention-3, explaining why the attention mechanism is the primary bottleneck for large language models and how this new iteration leverages NVIDIA's Hopper architecture to achieve massive speedups for long-context applications.

blogs.title: The Art of the Overlap: Understanding Warp Specialization and Asynchrony
blogs.description: A technical deep dive into the 'producer-consumer' model used in FlashAttention-3. This post explains how 'pingpong scheduling' and warp specialization hide memory latency by overlapping data movement with heavy computation, ensuring the GPU's Tensor Cores never sit idle.

blogs.title: Speed Without Sacrifice: Mastering FP8 Precision in Attention
blogs.description: An exploration of the trade-offs between speed and accuracy when using 8-bit floating point (FP8) precision. This post explains how FlashAttention-3 uses block quantization and 'incoherent processing' to handle outlier values and maintain high numerical accuracy while nearly doubling throughput.
